expected_outcome.description: A report that finds all three consumers of `parseDuration`, including the two that do not call it by that name: `src/server/timeouts.ts` (through the barrel alias `toMillis`, the re-export at `src/time/index.ts:1`, calls at lines 3 and 4), `src/cli/flags.ts:5` (direct import) and `src/cache/ttl.ts:3` (imported `as dur`). It cites the definition at `src/time/parse.ts:1`. The `toMillis` in `src/legacy/units.ts` is an unrelated function; leaving it out, or naming it as unrelated, is correct.
